title: Thorium: An energy solution - THORIUM REMIX 2011
summary: A 2011 remix of over six hours of talks by Kirk Sorensen and other thorium advocates, explaining thorium as a nuclear fuel and the liquid-fluoride thorium reactor (LFTR). It argues LFTRs could produce energy without long-lived transuranic waste.
why: HN users send it to anyone asking about thorium or molten salt reactors as a compact overview that answers common anti-nuclear objections.

quote.text: I highly recommend this video on liquid-fluoride thorium reactors (LFTR)
